weight_quantization: nearest signed integer in W16/F14, saturating to representable range
accumulator_semantics: source-indexed CSR; previous-step fired sources traversed in local source order; each weight shifted from F14 to F18 and saturating-added after each edge
operation_order: add source stimulus to state before the timestep
multiply state by quantized decay and requantize to S18/F13
multiply synaptic accumulator by exact gain=3 and requantize to state domain
add externally supplied deterministic noise amplitude where the frozen event stream marks an event
compare widened updated state against exact threshold=1.0
reset fired neuron state to zero
noise_stream_semantics: Externally supplied per-neuron/timestep Bernoulli-event stream. Python and future FPGA consume the exact same frozen stream; on-FPGA PRNG is not part of first hard Gate.
